title: Task planning constraints
content: Generate exactly seven distinct high-level tasks: list equipment; check availability; create reservation; list own reservations; reschedule reservation; cancel reservation; explain booking rules. Do not generate authentication, payment, notifications, hardware operation, or administrator tasks. Break write tasks into collection/validation, display confirmation, and commit. Do not actually perform any business operation while generating a plan.

sections.title: Supported scope
steps: A write must be confirmed after its fields are displayed.
Querying data is not permission to change it.
